title: HANA Backup Failure
evidence: Data backup failed. Backint returned SSL handshake error. backup.log shows failed external backup call.
resolution: Renewed expired client certificate for backint agent.

title: HANA Backup Failure
evidence: Log backups piling up. Backint could not reach backup target. Network timeout to storage endpoint.
resolution: Storage team restored backup target availability.

title: HANA log backup overdue
evidence: Log backup interval exceeded. Log volume filling up. Backint process hung.
resolution: Restarted backint agent, backups resumed.

title: Oracle RMAN backup failed
evidence: RMAN job ended with error. Archive log destination full.
resolution: Cleaned archive log destination and added space.

title: High dialog response time
evidence: Dialog response time above 2 seconds. Most work processes busy. Expensive SQL from a custom report.
resolution: Stopped long-running custom report and optimized its SQL.

title: SAP system slow for users
evidence: Users report slowness. High CPU on HANA host. Delta merge running during business hours.
resolution: Rescheduled delta merge outside business hours.

title: Long running batch jobs
evidence: Month-end batch jobs running twice as long. Database wait events on I/O.
resolution: Infrastructure team fixed storage I/O bottleneck.

title: HANA memory allocation limit reached
evidence: Column store unloads. Out of memory dumps. Large table fully loaded into memory.
resolution: Partitioned the large table and raised allocation limit.

title: HANA indexserver restart
evidence: Indexserver crashed and restarted. Crash dump matches a known bug in the revision.
resolution: Applied HANA revision update recommended by SAP Note.

title: RFC connection failure
evidence: RFC destination to external system failing. Certificate in STRUST expired, SSL handshake fails.
resolution: Imported new certificate in STRUST.

title: IDoc processing stuck
evidence: IDocs in status 64 not processed. Background job for RBDAPP01 not scheduled.
resolution: Rescheduled IDoc processing job.

title: Filesystem /usr/sap almost full
evidence: Filesystem usage at 95 percent. Old trace files and work directory logs accumulated.
resolution: Cleaned old traces and set up housekeeping.

title: HANA data backup failed
evidence: Data backup aborted after 40 minutes. Backint reported write error. Backup storage quota exceeded.
resolution: Storage team increased quota for the backup bucket.

title: HANA backup catalog too large
evidence: Backup catalog backups slow. Catalog contains entries older than two years. Housekeeping never ran.
resolution: Deleted old catalog entries and scheduled catalog housekeeping.

title: HANA backup failed after OS patching
evidence: Backint agent not starting after OS patch. Missing shared library reported in backint.log.
resolution: Reinstalled backint agent package for the new OS level.

title: Backint authentication failed
evidence: Backint returned access denied. Service account password for backup target was rotated.
resolution: Updated backint credentials in the agent configuration.

title: HANA backup slower than usual
evidence: Data backup took 6 hours instead of 2. Network throughput to backup target reduced.
resolution: Throughput recovered next day; network team found no cause.

title: HANA log backup failed, log area full
evidence: Log backups failing. Log volume reached 100 percent. Database suspended write transactions.
resolution: Fixed backint destination, triggered log backups, log area released.

title: Oracle RMAN backup slow
evidence: RMAN full backup exceeded maintenance window. Channels allocated: 1. Large datafiles.
resolution: Increased RMAN parallelism to 4 channels.

title: Oracle archivelog backup failed
evidence: Archivelog backup job failed. Media management library returned error. Tape library offline.
resolution: Backup team brought tape library back online.

title: Oracle backup catalog resync error
evidence: RMAN reported recovery catalog resync failure. Catalog database unreachable.
resolution: Restarted recovery catalog database listener.

title: Oracle archiver stuck
evidence: Alert log shows archiver stuck. Archive destination /oracle/CRP/oraarch full. Users cannot commit.
resolution: Moved archive logs to backup, freed space in oraarch.

title: BR*Tools backup failed
evidence: brbackup ended with return code 5. Parameter file initCRQ.sap points to wrong tape device.
resolution: Corrected backup device in initSID.sap.

title: Oracle backup verification failed
evidence: RMAN validate reported corrupt block in a datafile backup piece.
resolution: Took a new full backup; corruption not reproduced.

title: Dialog response time spikes at noon
evidence: Response time spikes daily around 12:00. Many users start the same heavy Fiori app.
resolution: Optimized Fiori app query and added caching.

title: Update work processes blocked
evidence: Update requests queuing in SM13. Update work processes all busy. One update task waiting on a lock.
resolution: Released the blocking lock and reprocessed updates.

title: Slow system after HANA upgrade
evidence: Statement response times doubled after revision upgrade. Plan cache invalidated, SQL plans changed.
resolution: Applied SAP Note with corrected hints, plans stabilized.

title: High CPU on application server
evidence: Application server CPU at 100 percent. One ABAP program in endless loop.
resolution: Cancelled the work process and corrected the program.

title: Users report timeouts in Fiori
evidence: Fiori apps time out. ICM threads exhausted. Many hanging HTTP connections.
resolution: Increased ICM threads and fixed keep-alive setting.

title: Background jobs delayed
evidence: Jobs start late. All background work processes busy with long-running reports.
resolution: Rescheduled reports; root cause not analysed further.

title: Enqueue table overflow
evidence: Users cannot save documents. Enqueue table full. Mass change program holding many locks.
resolution: Increased enqueue table size and split the mass change.

title: High memory usage in work processes
evidence: Work processes switching to PRIV mode. Extended memory exhausted.
resolution: Increased extended memory and fixed memory-heavy report.

title: Oracle high wait on log file sync
evidence: Commit times high. Wait event log file sync dominant. Redo logs on slow disks.
resolution: Moved redo logs to faster storage.

title: Oracle statistics outdated
evidence: Queries slow after data load. Optimizer statistics older than 3 months. Full table scans.
resolution: Gathered fresh optimizer statistics with BRCONNECT.

title: Oracle buffer cache too small
evidence: High physical reads. Buffer cache hit ratio below 80 percent after data growth.
resolution: Increased SGA and buffer cache.

title: SAP system slow, Oracle locks
evidence: Users wait on save. Oracle enqueue waits TX row lock. One session holding lock for hours.
resolution: Killed blocking session after business approval.

title: Slow transactions during backup
evidence: Dialog response slow every night between 01:00 and 03:00. Online backup saturating I/O.
resolution: Moved backup window and limited RMAN I/O rate.

title: HANA persistence volume full
evidence: Data volume disk at 98 percent. Savepoints slow. Large unused tables not cleaned.
resolution: Archived old data and extended data volume.

title: HANA too many delta merges
evidence: Delta storage large for several tables. Auto merge disabled by mistake.
resolution: Re-enabled auto merge and merged tables manually.

title: HANA nameserver not reachable
evidence: System replication secondary lost connection. Nameserver on primary restarted.
resolution: Connection recovered after restart; no clear cause.

title: HANA system replication out of sync
evidence: Replication status ERROR. Log shipping delayed. Network bandwidth between data centers saturated.
resolution: Network team prioritized replication traffic.

title: HANA license expired
evidence: Database in lockdown mode. Temporary license expired. Only SYSTEM user can log on.
resolution: Installed permanent license key.

title: HANA statement memory limit
evidence: Queries cancelled with statement memory limit error. Limit set too low after parameter change.
resolution: Restored statement_memory_limit to previous value.

title: HANA column store table corruption
evidence: Consistency check reported corruption in one column store table after storage incident.
resolution: Restored table from backup and reran consistency check.

title: HANA trace files filling disk
evidence: Trace directory growing fast. Debug trace level left active after support case.
resolution: Reset trace level and deleted large trace files.

title: Oracle tablespace full
evidence: PSAPSR3 tablespace 99 percent used. Inserts failing with ORA-01653.
resolution: Added datafile to tablespace.

title: Oracle listener down
evidence: Application servers cannot connect. Listener process stopped after server reboot.
resolution: Started listener and enabled autostart.

title: Oracle too many processes
evidence: New connections rejected with ORA-00020. Processes parameter too low after adding app servers.
resolution: Increased processes parameter and restarted database.

title: Oracle undo tablespace full
evidence: Long query failed with snapshot too old. Undo tablespace undersized.
resolution: Increased undo tablespace and undo retention.

title: Oracle datafile offline
evidence: Datafile marked offline after storage path change. Queries on affected tables fail.
resolution: Recovered datafile and set it online.

title: IDocs failing with status 51
evidence: Inbound IDocs status 51. Application error: material not found in plant.
resolution: Business team created missing master data and reprocessed IDocs.

title: qRFC queue blocked
evidence: Outbound qRFC queue stuck with SYSFAIL. Target system short dump in function module.
resolution: Fixed target function module and unlocked queue.

title: tRFC calls piling up
evidence: Many tRFC entries in SM58. Target system down for maintenance.
resolution: Reprocessed tRFC entries after target system was back.

title: SOAP web service call failing
evidence: Outbound SOAP calls return HTTP 401. Technical user password expired in target system.
resolution: Reset technical user password and updated logical port.

title: HTTPS call to external API failing
evidence: HTTP client returns SSL handshake error. Partner changed server certificate, new root CA not in STRUST.
resolution: Imported new root CA certificate in STRUST SSL client identity.

title: SFTP file transfer failed
evidence: Outbound file transfer failed. SFTP server host key changed, known_hosts mismatch.
resolution: Verified new host key with partner and updated known_hosts.

title: Inbound files not processed
evidence: Files arriving in interface directory but not picked up. Polling job cancelled after authorization change.
resolution: Restored job user authorization and restarted polling job.

title: RFC destination timeout
evidence: RFC calls to BW system time out. Gateway on target reached max connections.
resolution: Increased gateway max_conn and closed stale connections.

title: IDoc partner profile missing
evidence: Outbound IDocs status 29. Partner profile not maintained for new logical system.
resolution: Maintained partner profile in WE20.

title: RFC connection refused
evidence: RFC to legacy system fails with connection refused. Firewall rule removed during network change.
resolution: Network team restored firewall rule.

title: Interface job writes empty files
evidence: Outbound file generated with zero records. Selection variant changed by mistake.
resolution: Restored previous variant; change owner not identified.

title: Filesystem /hana/log full
evidence: Log filesystem 100 percent. Log backups failing to free segments because backint is down.
resolution: Fixed backint, ran log backups, log segments released.

title: Filesystem /hana/shared full
evidence: Shared filesystem 97 percent. Old installation media and support package archives stored there.
resolution: Removed old media and archives.

title: Host swapping heavily
evidence: Swap usage high on HANA host. Another process consuming memory outside HANA.
resolution: Moved monitoring agent with memory leak to another host.

title: NTP time drift on host
evidence: Host clock 7 minutes off. Kerberos and SSL logons failing. NTP service stopped.
resolution: Restarted NTP service and enabled it at boot.

title: CPU steal time high on VM
evidence: Slow processing. Hypervisor shows high CPU steal. Host overcommitted.
resolution: Infrastructure team moved VM to less loaded host.

title: Filesystem read-only after storage error
evidence: Filesystem remounted read-only. Kernel log shows I/O errors on storage path.
resolution: Storage path failed over; filesystem checked and remounted.

title: Too many open files
evidence: Application server errors: too many open files. ulimit nofile too low after OS rebuild.
resolution: Set nofile limit to SAP recommended value.

title: Filesystem /oracle/SID/sapdata full
evidence: sapdata filesystem 99 percent. Tablespace autoextend cannot grow.
resolution: Extended sapdata filesystem.

title: Filesystem /oracle/SID/saptrace full
evidence: Trace filesystem full. Oracle trace files from repeated errors accumulated.
resolution: Deleted old traces and fixed recurring error.

title: High I/O wait on database host
evidence: iowait above 40 percent. Multipath reports one path down.
resolution: Storage team replaced failed HBA cable.

title: Server reboot after kernel panic
evidence: Database host rebooted unexpectedly. Kernel panic in network driver.
resolution: Driver updated as precaution; panic not reproduced.

title: SSO logon failing for all users
evidence: SAML logon fails. Identity provider signing certificate renewed, not uploaded to SAP.
resolution: Uploaded new IdP certificate in SAML2 configuration.

title: SNC connection failed
evidence: SAP GUI SNC logon fails. SNC PSE expired on application server.
resolution: Renewed SNC PSE and restarted instance.

title: Certificate expiry warning
evidence: Monitoring shows SSL server certificate expires in 7 days on web dispatcher.
resolution: Renewed web dispatcher certificate before expiry.

title: HANA client connection TLS error
evidence: JDBC connections fail with TLS error after HANA enforced TLS 1.2. Old client library.
resolution: Upgraded HANA client on application servers.

title: Technical user locked
evidence: Batch interfaces failing. Technical user locked after wrong password attempts from old job.
resolution: Unlocked user and removed old job with stale password.

title: Oracle password expired for SAPSR3
evidence: Work processes cannot connect. Profile forced password expiry for schema user.
resolution: Reset password and assigned profile without expiry.

title: Critical job cancelled
evidence: Daily billing job cancelled with short dump TIME_OUT. Data volume doubled.
resolution: Split job by company code and ran in parallel.

title: Jobs not starting after restart
evidence: Released jobs stay in status released. No background work processes after instance profile change.
resolution: Restored rdisp/wp_no_btc and restarted instance.

title: Job chain stopped
evidence: Process chain in BW stopped. Predecessor job finished with warning, chain expected success.
resolution: Adjusted chain condition and restarted chain.

title: Spool overflow
evidence: Users cannot print. Spool numbers exhausted. Old spool requests not deleted.
resolution: Deleted old spools and scheduled RSPO1041.

title: Reorganization job running too long
evidence: Standard housekeeping job running 10 hours. Table it cleans grew very large.
resolution: Job finished; follow-up analysis pending.

title: Job failed after password change
evidence: Scheduled job fails with logon error. Job step user password changed.
resolution: Changed job step user to a system user.

title: Transport import failed
evidence: Transport ended with return code 8. Object locked in another request.
resolution: Released lock and re-imported transport.

title: tp hanging during import
evidence: Import queue hanging. tp waiting for RDDIMPDP job, job not scheduled.
resolution: Scheduled RDDIMPDP and restarted import.

title: Kernel upgrade caused dumps
evidence: Short dumps after kernel patch. Kernel files mixed versions in exe directory.
resolution: Reinstalled complete kernel set.

title: Instance not starting
evidence: Application server instance does not start. Message server port in use by stale process.
resolution: Killed stale process and started instance.

title: License warning in SAP system
evidence: System shows temporary license warning. Hardware key changed after VM migration.
resolution: Requested and installed new license for new hardware key.

title: Instance startup fails after Oracle patch
evidence: Work processes cannot connect after Oracle patch. Oracle client in kernel not updated.
resolution: Updated Oracle instant client used by SAP kernel.

title: Oracle wallet certificate expired
evidence: Outbound HTTPS from database fails. Oracle wallet certificate expired, SSL verification error.
resolution: Renewed certificate in Oracle wallet.

title: Unexpected admin logons
evidence: Security audit log shows SAP* logon attempts from unknown host.
resolution: Host blocked; investigation handed to security team.

title: Job server group misconfigured
evidence: Jobs run only on one server. Server group points to decommissioned host.
resolution: Updated job server group.

title: Year-end job failed
evidence: Year-end closing job failed with number range exhausted.
resolution: Extended number range interval and restarted job.

title: Short dumps DBIF_RSQL_SQL_ERROR
evidence: Many short dumps with SQL error. HANA connection lost briefly during failover test.
resolution: Confirmed dumps during planned failover window; no action.

title: Message server not reachable
evidence: Logon groups not working. Message server down after host name change.
resolution: Corrected message server host in profiles.

title: Slow logon to SAP GUI
evidence: SAP GUI logon takes 30 seconds. DNS reverse lookup timing out.
resolution: Fixed reverse DNS entries for client network.

title: Disk latency spikes on HANA data volume
evidence: Savepoint duration over 5 minutes. Storage latency spikes during snapshot jobs.
resolution: Moved storage snapshots outside business hours.

title: Event Mesh messages not consumed
evidence: Messages piling up in queue. Consumer webhook returns HTTP 500 after deployment.
resolution: Rolled back faulty deployment of consumer service.

title: HANA savepoint taking very long
evidence: Savepoint duration high. Critical phase blocked by long-running write transaction.
resolution: Transaction finished; monitoring added.

title: HANA backup failed, backint certificate chain incomplete
evidence: Data backup failed. backint.log: certificate verify failed, unable to get local issuer certificate. Intermediate CA missing on host.
resolution: Added intermediate CA to backint trust store.

title: HANA backup failed after hostname change
evidence: Backint rejected connection. Server certificate name does not match new backup endpoint hostname.
resolution: Requested certificate with correct SAN for new endpoint.

title: HANA tenant backup missing
evidence: Backup of one tenant database not in catalog. Backup schedule created only for SYSTEMDB.
resolution: Added schedule for all tenant databases.

title: HANA backup encryption key error
evidence: Backup failed: root key backup missing. Encryption enabled without backing up root keys.
resolution: Backed up root keys and reran data backup.

title: Backint process killed by OOM
evidence: Backint agent terminated. OS OOM killer selected backint during peak memory usage.
resolution: Limited backint buffer size and added memory to host.

title: HANA backup slow, parallel streams too low
evidence: Backup duration doubled after data growth. parallel_data_backup_backint_channels set to 1.
resolution: Increased backint channels to 4.

title: HANA log backups not deleted
evidence: Log backup files accumulating on local disk. Retention policy disabled.
resolution: Enabled retention policy and cleaned old log backups.

title: HANA backup failed, clock skew
evidence: Backint auth to cloud storage failed: request time too skewed. Host time 15 minutes off.
resolution: Fixed NTP synchronization on host.

title: Oracle RMAN failed, FRA full
evidence: RMAN error ORA-19809 limit exceeded for recovery files. Fast recovery area full.
resolution: Deleted obsolete backups and increased db_recovery_file_dest_size.

title: Oracle backup to tape timeout
evidence: RMAN channel timed out waiting for tape mount. Backup software queue overloaded.
resolution: Backup succeeded on retry.

title: Oracle archivelogs deleted before backup
evidence: Recovery gap detected. Archive logs deleted by OS cleanup script before RMAN backed them up.
resolution: Removed OS cleanup script, took new full backup.

title: Oracle backup control file error
evidence: RMAN could not back up control file autobackup. Path for autobackup does not exist.
resolution: Created directory and corrected autobackup format.

title: Oracle offline backup could not shut down database
evidence: brbackup offline failed. Database shutdown hanging on active sessions.
resolution: Stopped SAP before backup and used shutdown immediate.

title: HANA backup failed, storage bucket permissions
evidence: Backint write denied. Bucket policy changed by cloud team, service account lost write role.
resolution: Restored storage write role for service account.

title: HANA delta backup failed
evidence: Incremental backup failed: no full data backup found as basis after catalog cleanup.
resolution: Took new full backup, incremental schedule resumed.

title: Slow MRP run
evidence: MRP run 3 hours longer. Missing secondary index after table conversion.
resolution: Created index recommended by SAP Note.

title: High response time for one user group
evidence: Only users from one site slow. WAN link to that site saturated.
resolution: Network team upgraded WAN bandwidth.

title: Fiori launchpad slow to open
evidence: Launchpad load takes 20 seconds. Too many tiles and catalogs assigned to role.
resolution: Cleaned up role catalogs and tile assignments.

title: HANA high CPU from many parallel queries
evidence: HANA CPU at 100 percent. Analytics tool firing hundreds of parallel queries.
resolution: Configured workload class to limit parallelism for tool user.

title: Dialog work processes stuck in RFC
evidence: All dialog work processes waiting on synchronous RFC to slow external system.
resolution: Changed interface to asynchronous call.

title: Slow response after table growth
evidence: Change document tables grew to 2 billion rows. Queries reading change history slow.
resolution: Archiving project started; no immediate fix.

title: Buffer synchronization delays
evidence: Users see old data on some app servers. Table buffer synchronization interval too high.
resolution: Reset rdisp/bufreftime to default.

title: Program buffer swaps
evidence: High program buffer swaps after many new custom programs. Response time increased.
resolution: Increased program buffer size.

title: Dialog response time high during month-end
evidence: Response time doubles on last working day. Many heavy financial reports started at once.
resolution: Moved heavy reports to background with time slots.

title: Oracle high db file sequential read
evidence: Queries waiting on single block reads. Index on large table fragmented.
resolution: Rebuilt index online.

title: Oracle library cache contention
evidence: High library cache lock waits. Application parsing statements without bind variables.
resolution: Fixed custom code to use bind variables.

title: Oracle temp tablespace full during report
evidence: Report failed with unable to extend temp segment. Large sort in custom report.
resolution: Increased temp tablespace and optimized report.

title: Slow system after Oracle parameter change
evidence: Many full table scans after optimizer_index_cost_adj changed to non-SAP value.
resolution: Reset parameter to SAP recommended value.

title: High CPU on Oracle host
evidence: CPU at 95 percent. One SQL statement with changed plan doing millions of buffer gets.
resolution: Pinned good plan with SQL plan baseline.

title: Slow HANA after column store reload
evidence: Queries slow after restart. Column tables loaded lazily on first access.
resolution: Configured preload for critical tables.

title: HANA out of memory dump
evidence: OOM dump in indexserver. Single query consumed 400 GB due to missing join condition.
resolution: Fixed query and set statement memory limit.

title: HANA alert: long running transaction
evidence: Transaction open for 20 hours. MVCC versions growing, memory usage rising.
resolution: Cancelled idle session holding the transaction.

title: HANA table lock wait
evidence: Several sessions waiting on table lock. DDL statement on large table during business hours.
resolution: Postponed DDL to maintenance window.

title: HANA system replication takeover
evidence: Primary site lost power. Takeover to secondary executed by cluster.
resolution: Primary rebuilt and replication re-established.

title: HANA disk full on trace volume
evidence: Trace volume full. Expensive statements trace enabled with very low threshold.
resolution: Raised trace threshold and removed old trace files.

title: HANA LOB storage growing
evidence: Data volume grows fast. Attachments stored as LOBs in database.
resolution: Content repository migration planned.

title: HANA xsengine not starting
evidence: XS engine service fails to start after upgrade. Port conflict with another service.
resolution: Changed XS engine port.

title: HANA user locked, too many failed logons
evidence: Application user locked. Old client with wrong password retrying every second.
resolution: Fixed client configuration and unlocked user.

title: Oracle ORA-01555 in batch job
evidence: Batch job failed with snapshot too old. Long query concurrent with mass updates.
resolution: Increased undo retention and rescheduled job.

title: Oracle redo log switches too frequent
evidence: Log switches every minute during load. Redo logs too small.
resolution: Increased redo log size to 2 GB.

title: Oracle deadlock detected
evidence: Alert log shows ORA-00060 deadlocks. Two custom programs update same tables in opposite order.
resolution: Changed program update order.

title: Oracle control file corrupted
evidence: Database fails to mount. One control file copy corrupted after storage error.
resolution: Restored control file from mirror copy.

title: Oracle sessions killed by resource limit
evidence: Sessions terminated with idle time exceeded. Profile idle_time set for SAP schema.
resolution: Removed idle_time from profile.

title: Oracle ORA-04031 shared pool
evidence: Errors unable to allocate shared memory. Shared pool fragmented.
resolution: Increased shared pool and flushed it.

title: HANA consistency check found issues
evidence: Table consistency check reported mismatches after aborted data load.
resolution: Reloaded affected data; cause of abort unknown.

title: Outbound HTTPS call failing after proxy change
evidence: HTTP client returns connect timeout. Corporate proxy host changed, SM59 still uses old proxy.
resolution: Updated proxy settings in SM59.

title: OData service returns 500
evidence: Fiori app error. OData service dump due to missing authorization object check.
resolution: Corrected role and service implementation.

title: IDocs in status 30
evidence: Outbound IDocs remain status 30. Output mode set to collect, sending job not scheduled.
resolution: Scheduled RSEOUT00 job.

title: bgRFC queue errors
evidence: bgRFC units in error. Destination missing after system copy.
resolution: Recreated bgRFC destination.

title: Interface to bank failing, certificate
evidence: Payment file upload to bank fails with SSL error. Client certificate for bank expired.
resolution: Renewed client certificate and updated STRUST.

title: RFC logon failure
evidence: RFC calls fail with logon error. Trusted RFC relationship broken after system refresh.
resolution: Re-established trusted RFC.

title: Message queue full in integration
evidence: Integration flow messages queued. Target adapter paused after error threshold.
resolution: Fixed target error and resumed adapter.

title: EDI partner sends duplicate files
evidence: Duplicate inbound orders created. Partner resends file after missing acknowledgement.
resolution: Fixed acknowledgement sending and added duplicate check.

title: Web service response slow
evidence: SOAP calls take 30 seconds. Target system performs full table scan for each call.
resolution: Target team investigating.

title: RFC to SAP BW fails
evidence: RFC destination error: partner not reached. Target gateway service not started.
resolution: Started gateway on target.

title: File interface encoding problem
evidence: Inbound file special characters broken. File sent in UTF-8, interface expects Latin-1.
resolution: Changed interface code page.

title: SAPconnect mails not sent
evidence: Outbound mails stuck in SOST. SMTP server certificate changed, TLS handshake fails.
resolution: Imported new SMTP server CA in STRUST.

title: Data replication to BW delayed
evidence: Delta queue in RSA7 growing. Collective run job not running.
resolution: Rescheduled collective run job.

title: HTTP 403 from external API
evidence: Calls to partner API rejected with 403. API key rotated by partner.
resolution: Updated API key in secure store.

title: IDoc processing slow
evidence: Inbound IDocs processed with delay. Serialization forces single-threaded processing.
resolution: Under review with business.

title: Filesystem /usr/sap/trans full
evidence: Transport directory 100 percent. Old data and cofiles never cleaned.
resolution: Archived old transport files.

title: Host memory exhausted by page cache
evidence: HANA allocation failed although host had free memory in page cache. Global allocation limit misconfigured.
resolution: Corrected global_allocation_limit.

title: Network interface errors on host
evidence: Packet drops on database host NIC. Bonding misconfigured after maintenance.
resolution: Fixed bonding configuration.

title: SELinux blocking SAP process
evidence: sapstartsrv cannot start. SELinux denied access after OS hardening.
resolution: Adjusted SELinux policy per SAP Note.

title: Transparent huge pages enabled
evidence: Latency spikes on HANA. THP enabled after OS update.
resolution: Disabled THP per SAP recommendation.

title: Mount point missing after reboot
evidence: Instance does not start. /hana/shared not mounted, fstab entry lost.
resolution: Restored fstab entry and mounted filesystem.

title: DNS resolution slow on host
evidence: SAP startup slow. DNS server in resolv.conf unreachable, timeouts on each lookup.
resolution: Fixed resolv.conf nameservers.

title: Filesystem /oracle/SID/origlogA full
evidence: Online redo log filesystem full due to copied files left by admin.
resolution: Removed copied files.

title: Oracle host out of semaphores
evidence: Database startup fails. Kernel semaphore limits too low after OS reinstall.
resolution: Set kernel semaphore parameters.

title: Disk failure in RAID
evidence: Storage reports degraded RAID. Database performance slightly reduced.
resolution: Replaced failed disk.

title: Clock jump on database host
evidence: Oracle reported time jump. NTP corrected large offset at once.
resolution: NTP configured to slew; no impact found.

title: Filesystem /hana/data growing fast
evidence: Data filesystem growth 5 percent per day. Large staging table filled by interface.
resolution: Cleaned staging table and fixed interface cleanup.

title: Web dispatcher certificate expired
evidence: Users get browser certificate error. Web dispatcher server certificate expired overnight.
resolution: Installed renewed certificate on web dispatcher.

title: Kerberos SSO failing
evidence: SPNego logon fails. Service account password changed, keytab not updated.
resolution: Regenerated keytab.

title: HANA SSL certificate expired for clients
evidence: Applications cannot connect to HANA via TLS. HANA server certificate expired.
resolution: Renewed HANA server certificate in PSE.

title: Critical authorization assigned by mistake
evidence: SAP_ALL assigned to dialog user in production during role copy.
resolution: Removed profile and reviewed role process.

title: Audit log not written
evidence: Security audit log empty. Audit log filesystem full.
resolution: Extended filesystem and archived audit files.

title: Oracle TLS listener error
evidence: Encrypted connections fail. Listener wallet missing new server certificate.
resolution: Updated wallet and restarted listener.

title: Users cannot log on, password rules
evidence: New password policy rejects all initial passwords from identity tool.
resolution: Aligned identity tool password rules.

title: SAML assertion rejected
evidence: SSO fails: assertion expired. Clock difference between IdP and SAP server.
resolution: Fixed NTP on SAP server.

title: Database user locked by audit policy
evidence: SAP schema user locked after failed logons from monitoring tool.
resolution: Updated monitoring credentials and unlocked user.

title: Certificate for RFC SNC expired
evidence: SNC-protected RFC to other system fails. Partner SNC certificate expired.
resolution: Exchanged renewed SNC certificates.

title: Payroll job cancelled
evidence: Payroll run cancelled with dump. Program buffer overflow during peak.
resolution: Reran successfully at night.

title: Job runs twice
evidence: Interface job duplicated data. Same job scheduled in two clients.
resolution: Removed duplicate job definition.

title: Event-triggered job not started
evidence: Job waiting for event never started. Event raised with wrong parameter.
resolution: Corrected event parameter in raising program.

title: Housekeeping jobs missing
evidence: Tables like BALDAT growing. Standard housekeeping jobs never scheduled after migration.
resolution: Scheduled standard jobs.

title: Job log tables huge
evidence: TBTCO and job logs very large. Job log deletion job inactive.
resolution: Activated deletion of old job logs.

title: External job scheduler lost connection
evidence: Jobs from external scheduler not starting. XBP interface user locked.
resolution: Unlocked XBP user and changed password policy.

title: Batch input sessions in error
evidence: Batch input sessions stopped. Screen changed after support package.
resolution: Updated batch input recording.

title: Statistics job failed
evidence: BRCONNECT statistics job failed with ORA-01652 temp space.
resolution: Increased temp tablespace.

title: Job ran on wrong server
evidence: Job failed because it needs local file. Executed on different app server.
resolution: Bound job to correct target server.

title: System copy post-processing incomplete
evidence: Copied system sends mails to production partners. RFC destinations not adjusted.
resolution: Locked outbound destinations and completed post-copy steps.

title: Support package import stuck
evidence: SPAM stuck in phase XPRA. One XPRA report dumping.
resolution: Applied correction note and continued import.

title: Instance profile parameter wrong
evidence: Work processes restarting. Parameter typo in instance profile.
resolution: Corrected profile parameter.

title: SAP router connection down
evidence: SAP support cannot connect. saprouter process stopped after server patch.
resolution: Restarted saprouter and enabled service.

title: SAP GUI logon error after kernel patch
evidence: Users get error on logon. Old SAP GUI version incompatible with new kernel feature.
resolution: Rolled out newer SAP GUI version.

title: Central instance cannot start
evidence: Startup fails: shared memory segments still present after crash.
resolution: Cleaned shared memory with cleanipc.

title: Number range buffer issue
evidence: Gaps in document numbers. Number range buffering active on legally required object.
resolution: Disabled buffering for that number range.

title: Short dumps after transport
evidence: Many dumps after transport import. Missing dependent transport.
resolution: Imported missing transport.

title: Profile parameters lost after system copy
evidence: System uses default memory settings after copy. Profiles overwritten.
resolution: Restored from backup; process reviewed.
